notes: GENUINE Taiwan Alpha datasheet '9mm Rotary Type, Snap-In, Insulated Shaft' (RV09 series), 7 sheets + Mouser cover. Filed under RV09AF-40 because that is the vertical single-gang variant, but the file covers the whole 9 mm family. Bushing: the plain -40 has NO bushing (snap-in only); the E1 suffix is a METAL M9 x 0.75 bushing and E1N a plastic D9 bushing. CENTRE DETENT = order-code suffix 0C ('with center click'), click torque 20-120 gf.cm, rotation life 5000 cycles with click vs 10000 without. Tapers A (log), B (linear), C (rev-log), 1 k to 500 k and 1 M. Rotational angle 280+/-5 deg (RV09A) or 300+/-5 deg (RV09B).

REPRESENTATIVE 100mA polyfuse, NOT the BOM package. MF-PSMF series is 0805, the F-CHAIN row asks for 1206. Page 2 carries the Typical Time to Trip curves for the whole series (the hold/trip curve that was wanted). NOTE FOR THE DESIGN: 1.0-7.5 ohm of series resistance on a 3V3 rail at 100mA is 0.1-0.75V of drop - that is the number to check, not the trip point. ALTERNATIVE CHECKED AND REJECTED: Littelfuse POLYFUSE USBR series (gitlab.com/timofonic/breadboard-psu/-/raw/master/Datasheets/Littelfuse-Polyfuse_Resettable_PTCs-USBR_Series.pdf) is RADIAL LEADED with Ihold 0.75-2.5A - no 100mA part and the wrong form factor. R-78E-1.0 series, REV 9/2024. ANSWERS ALL FOUR OPEN QUESTIONS. Derating (p3 graph, digitised): 100% load to +60C ambient, then linear to 60% at +85C (-1.6%/C), hard cutoff at 85C. Switching frequency 330kHz for 3.3V and 5V outputs (570kHz for 12V) - the 330kHz assumption is CONFIRMED. Max capacitive load 220uF (nominal Vin, full resistive load). Input range for the 5.0V part is 8-28V, NOT the 7-28V on the features line (that is the 3.3V part). Short circuit protection: continuous, automatic recovery. Also: output accuracy +-3% typ/+-5% max, ripple 120mVp-p (20MHz BW, 100nF MLCC across output), quiescent 1.5mA, no minimum load on the 5V part, 'cannot be used as positive to negative converter', EN55032 external filter table given.
